description_en: Enables or disables the deep packet inspection (DPI) feature for a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 设置指定智能接入网关实例的深度监控开关状态
kebab_example: aliyun smartag set-advanced-monitor-state --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --sag-id sag-0000 --enable true --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetAdvancedMonitorState

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SAG instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: sag_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the DPI feature. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes
*   **false**: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用深度监控开关。取值：

- **true**：是。
- **false**：否
parameters.name: enable
